providers.note: Engineering and B.Arch degrees affiliated to Tribhuvan University IOE.

providers.name: Kathmandu University School of Medical Sciences

providers.name: B. P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences

scholarships.name: UGC Nepal fellowships
scholarships.covers: Research stipend and fees for selected fellows
scholarships.how: Apply when the commission publishes a notice

scholarships.name: CTEVT scholarships for target groups
scholarships.covers: Reduced or free seats for women, Dalit, Janajati, remote and low income students
scholarships.who: Students from the target groups in diploma programmes
scholarships.how: Mark the scholarship quota in the CTEVT admission form

scholarships.name: MOEST and MEC National Scholarship Quotas
scholarships.by: Ministry of Education (MOEST) and Medical Education Commission
scholarships.covers: 75% of public medical seats and 10 to 20% of private college seats (55% open merit, 45% inclusive reservation for community school and target groups)
scholarships.who: Nepali citizens ranking high in MECEE-BL or university scholarship entrances
scholarships.how: Apply in the open and reserved categories on entrance.mec.gov.np or the university scholarship portal

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships (UK)
scholarships.by: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, monthly living stipend, return flights and visa for a one-year UK master degree
scholarships.who: Nepali graduates with at least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience and leadership potential
scholarships.how: Apply online between August and November; shortlisted candidates interview at the British Embassy Kathmandu

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Scholarships (UK)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, airfare and thesis grant
scholarships.who: Graduates with strong academics and development impact, via nominating agencies or shared university tracks
scholarships.how: Apply on the CSC portal and through the nominating agency or UK university during the autumn call

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (USA)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, monthly living stipend, health insurance and round-trip airfare
scholarships.who: Nepali graduates with strong academics, a four-year degree and two to three years of professional work experience
scholarships.how: Apply through USEF-Nepal in Kathmandu when the annual spring call opens

scholarships.name: DAAD EPOS and Study Scholarships (Germany)
scholarships.covers: Monthly stipend (EUR 934 for master, EUR 1,300 for PhD), health insurance and travel allowance
scholarships.who: Graduates with strong grades; EPOS development courses ask for at least two years of relevant work experience
scholarships.how: Apply directly to the participating German university and the DAAD portal by the programme deadline

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarships
scholarships.by: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Australia)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, return air travel, establishment allowance and fortnightly living stipend
scholarships.who: Nepali citizens working in priority development sectors with a return service commitment
scholarships.how: Apply online via the OASIS portal between February and April

scholarships.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
scholarships.covers: 100% tuition, monthly stipend (JPY 117,000 for undergraduate/college of technology, JPY 143,000 to 145,000 for master/PhD) and return flights
scholarships.who: Nepali citizens meeting age and GPA bars (around 75% in SEE/+2 for science undergrad, 70% in bachelor for research)
scholarships.how: Apply via the Embassy of Japan in Kathmandu (written exam and interview, no application fee) or university track

scholarships.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS / KGSP)
scholarships.by: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), South Korea
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, 1-year Korean language training, monthly allowance (KRW 1,140,000 for bachelor, KRW 1,380,000 for graduate) and airfare
scholarships.who: Nepali citizens with 80%+ or 2.64/4.0 GPA in their previous level and within age limits
scholarships.how: Apply via the Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Kathmandu or directly to a designated Korean university

scholarships.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
scholarships.who: Nepali applicants meeting age and academic conditions
scholarships.how: Apply online and choose universities; the Chinese Embassy or the Ministry can give details

scholarships.name: Stipendium Hungaricum (Hungary)
scholarships.covers: Tuition, stipend, housing support and insurance
scholarships.who: Nepali students nominated through the national partner
scholarships.how: Apply on the official portal when the call is open

scholarships.name: Turkiye Burslari
scholarships.covers: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend and flights
scholarships.who: Strong academic record and age limits
scholarships.how: Apply online in the winter call

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.covers: Full or partial fee waiver and a monthly allowance
scholarships.how: Apply directly to each joint master programme
